title: Seeded verification acceptance probability
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $s:\{0,1\}^r\to\mathbb{F}_2^n$ be a seed map. The seeded verification acceptance probability is the expectation, over a uniformly random Boolean vector $b\in\{0,1\}^r$, of $1$ when the seeded verification result is true and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Seed map from $r$ Boolean bits to $\mathbb{F}_2^n$
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the matrix product verification decision, so its exact acceptance criterion is unavailable.
